core.title: 3/4 Inch Offset Intermediate Pivot, Rixson M19

text.description_html:
Rixson M19 Commercial Intermediate Door Pivot Set

These 3/4" offset intermediate pivots are engineered for durability for use on standard commercial doors. Set includes intermediate pivot with installation hardware.

Specifications: for Rixson M19 Intermediate Door Pivot

  • Offset: 3/4"
  • Hinge Leaf Height: 5"
  • Hinge Leaf Width: 1-1/8"
  • Hinge Type: Full Mortise
  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Supplied with wood and machine screws
  • Handed - Must specify left hand door or right hand door when ordering

*Important When selecting Door Hand for this pivot hinge:
1. Stand on the Push Side of the door, facing the door.
2. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Left", choose "Left Hand Door".
3. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Right", choose "Right Hand Door".
